title: Trash Pickup Day Schedule (2022)
description: Data Dictionary: Label Definition parcel_id The unique Parcel ID assigned to this address. StNum The street number for that address. StName The name of the Street that this address is located on. FullAddress The full address of this house, including the number from StNum and the street name from StName. Zip The Zip Code that this address is located in. TrashDay The day of the week that trash is picked up at this address.
